title: W9 B5 -- Place the caret on a blank-page click
description: Follow section '### B5 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: blankClick.test.ts, tests/w9-blank-click.spec.ts, pages-gap, ruler and footnotes specs pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1438. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/B5.md.

review.note:
Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). src/editor/blankClick.ts follows PLAN B5 steps 2-4 exactly (guards: button, ctrl/meta/alt, any descendant of view.dom other than view.dom, ruler/side-ruler/page-spacer/footnote marker/controls; below last child -> doc end; else clamped posAtCoords; shift extends from anchor; scrollIntoView, preventDefault, focus). Wired at Writer.tsx:2081 (T0). Fail-first B5-fail-first.txt: both modes failed on the stub. Step (e) change checked as asked: plan (e) only requires that a click inside text behaves as before; it does not ask for a click that replaces an existing selection. The old version happened to click inside the (d) shift selection, which is the browser drag-start path that settles on mouse-up, hence the race. The new version collapses to first.start+1, clicks mid-text and polls for the caret to move inside paragraph one, empty selection, focus kept: the inside-text case is still tested, nothing the plan asks for was removed. blankPageClick returns false for any click whose target is inside view.dom (e.g. the

), so selection-replacing clicks never reach it. Fresh runs: npx vitest run src/editor/blankClick.test.ts -> 15/15; npx tsc -b -> exit 0; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1438 npx playwright test tests/w9-blank-click.spec.ts tests/pages-gap.spec.ts tests/ruler.spec.ts tests/footnotes.spec.ts --output test-results/T262-review -> 56 passed, 0 failed. Gaps for T277/T278 (not blocking): plan (e) ruler/footnote-marker/page-gap clicks are covered only by the existing specs, not in the new spec; the plan's stop rule 'in a split, a blank click in the unfocused pane does not move the toolbar to that pane' was not checked (App.tsx not owned): check it in the owner hand check, and the 150% zoom and WebKit cases.
